card.text: A brown dwarf of about 20 Jupiter masses, watched by GRAVITY for the wobble of a moon.

sources.label: Kral et al. 2026
sources.quote: This enabled us to isolate potential residual wobbles in the motion of component B attributable to an orbiting moon

introduction.text: HD 206893 B is a dusty brown dwarf 11 au from its star. Small wobbles in its motion could be a moon of about 0.4 Jupiter masses, or instrument errors.

sources.label: Kral et al. 2026
sources.quote: the origin of these residuals remains ambiguous and could be due to systematics

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A sphere of the model radius, glowing with its own heat. No surface, colour or spin is measured.
